incidents.title: Thank you to the kind stranger who brought my package over to Queen st after it was accidentally delivered to your home
incidents.summary: U big dawg! you saved me (probably hours) from having to deal with purolator customer service and Shark vacuum customer service (which is so soul sucking lol). My roommate had no idea it was delivered to the wrong house so when you dropped it off she probably thought you were the delivery person. When she texted me an update, I was so so relieved. But this meant I didn't get the chance to properly thank you- Thank you very much <3 (and I do mean very). And to everyone else if you've ever done this, thank you. You probably don't realize how much stress you've saved someone.
